midnight.text: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.

dawn.text: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place?

noon.text: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.

evening.text: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide.

midnight.text: But none saith, Where is God my maker, who giveth songs in the night.

dawn.text: He wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.

noon.text: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

evening.text: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.

midnight.text: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.

dawn.text: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

noon.text: Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour.

evening.text: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

midnight.text: Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.

dawn.text: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning.

noon.text: He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.

evening.text: Sit still, my daughter, until thou know how the matter will fall: for the man will not be in rest, until he have finished the thing this day.

midnight.text: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.

dawn.text: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.

noon.text: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.

evening.text: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.

midnight.text: I sleep, but my heart waketh: it is the voice of my beloved that knocketh.

dawn.text: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

noon.text: In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength.

evening.text: Thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

midnight.text: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.

dawn.text: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.

noon.text: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.

evening.text: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night.
